title: Explorer 1 launched on Imbolc

tellings.quote: Over 20 years later, Explorer 1, the first US satellite built by JPL, was launched on January 31st, 1958.

plain: Explorer 1, the first US satellite, built by the Jet Propulsion Laboratory (JPL, the NASA-linked rocket lab in California), was launched on January 31st, 1958, which Michels points out falls on Imbolc, an old pagan festival held at the start of February. Michels makes the link himself, as part of a wider argument about pagan ritual in the space program. If the timing was deliberate, it would mean the early American space effort was shaped by occult beliefs.
